title: M5 Repair Preview Row Component Fragment
description: Component fragment for the reusable M5 repair preview row rendered inside the repair action card and across the Project Doctor panel, guided repair wizard, support-bundle repair row, repair preview sheet, and remote-host repair card. The row always preserves the four pre-execution truths in text (preview_only, approval_required, rerunnable, and factory_reset_out_of_band are mandatory) and always identifies both the changed and the unchanged state classes so a user can judge risk before a fix runs. This fragment is governed by the packet schema schemas/ui/m5-repair-action-card.schema.json.

repair_title.description: Opaque, export-safe repair identity the preview row annotates.

changed_classes.description: The state classes this repair changes; empty only for a no-writes preview.

unchanged_classes.description: The state classes this repair leaves untouched.

rendered_parts.description: The preview-row parts this instance renders; must include all four pre-execution flags and both change-class lists.

accessibility_routes.description: Non-visual routes; the row must be keyboard focusable and non-hover reachable so no pre-execution truth is hover-only.
